name: AI Answer Guard
description: Check AI answers before you rely on them: spot repeated or conflicting sources, compare claims of completed tasks with actual tool results, and flag missing permissions. Free, local, read-only MCP for Python 3. Install with `qwen extensions install Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive` or [MCPB v1.2.0](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/releases/tag/mcp-router-v1.2.0). [Setup guide](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/AI_ANSWER_GUARD_INSTALL.md).
